verdict.rationale: Algolia ships official open-source InstantSearch UI libraries with predefined widgets, such as refinementList for facets. Customization goes from predefined widgets, to customized widgets, to fully custom widgets. The React quickstart builds a search interface that filters by product type and paginates. Independent users praise React InstantSearch as easy to add and note InstantSearch covers vanilla JS, React, Vue, Angular, iOS and Android. Missing for 10: the evidence never explicitly names the search-box and hits/results widgets, so those parts of the story are only implied by the quickstart.
